$comment: Audio catalog for tools/gen_audio.mjs (ElevenLabs) and tools/placeholder_audio.sh (local ffmpeg). One entry per final file. Paths are relative to seria/. Prompts are verbatim from the bible (sec. 7.2-7.4, 4.4) unless noted in 'note'. durationS = exact final length (trim/pad); maxS = natural length capped. 'library': true = only generated with --library (not used by S01E01).

doctor.description:
Native English. Female, late 60s. Studio quality.
Persona: underpaid, deadpan therapist. Emotion: flat, bored, unshockable.
A very low, slow, monotone voice with a dry, slightly nasal hum and a lazy closed-mouth delivery; long pauses and very little pitch movement, usually flat, but capable of rare sudden sharp reactions.
doctor.previewText: Mm-hm. Go on. So the toaster left you, and now you feel like crumbs. I see. And how does that make you feel? Interesting. That will be ninety dollars. Time is up. Same time next week. Mm-hm. Mm-hm?
doctor.note: bible 3.1 (prompt + preview text verbatim). fallbackVoiceId = premade 'Matilda' (alto), used only if saving the designed voice fails (account voice slots).

patient_vp6.description:
Native English. Male, 40s. Studio quality.
Persona: dead-eyed office drone. Emotion: numb, resigned, tired.
A flat, mumbling, mid-low voice with no energy, words trailing off at the end.
patient_vp6.previewText: Copy. Scan. Print. Repeat. Twenty-four hours a day, four hundred pages at three in the morning, and nobody ever says thank you. Print it again? In color? ... ... No.
patient_vp6.note: bible 4.4 VP6 prompt verbatim. The account has no free voice slot for a second designed voice, so the one clear word 'No.' is cut from the Voice Design preview (last phrase after the long pause) instead of saving the voice. fallbackVoiceId = premade 'Bill', used only if the cut fails.

clips.prompt: Quiet small office at night, faint distant city traffic, steady, no voices
clips.note: ElevenLabs loops export as MP3 only: decoded to 48 kHz, tiled to >= L+F samples, then report command 5 (qsin 100 ms tail->head) to exactly 3,072,000 samples.

clips.prompt:
Instrumental, 120 BPM, 4/4, D minor, loopable, consistent energy, no intro, no ending, no outro.
Deadpan waiting-room lounge jazz: muted upright bass walking line, brushed snare, dry electric piano chords,
occasional soft vibraphone notes. Cheap, slightly worn and melancholic but quietly comedic. Sparse, leaves room
for sound effects and a ticking clock. 72 seconds, steady dynamics throughout.
clips.note: bible 7.4 prompt; length asked as 72 s (not 64) to leave whole bars for the bar-aligned cut. Post: tempo check (atempo to exactly 120 BPM if drifted), downbeat placed at 0.25 s + 2k s (bible 6.2), report command 5.

clips.prompt: (code) SFX01_tick placed at sample 12000 + k*24000, k = 0..127
clips.note: CONTRACT 8: pre-rendered tick track (the 12,000-sample offset is 7.5 frames).
